contract: ../ui-contract.md: OpenCV desktop studio, 1120x704 and 960x640, keyboard controls, retained failed captures, contrast and reduced-motion checks.

accessibility.evidence: Local regression tests cover Tab/Enter dispatch, visible focus state, 44px targets and 4.5:1 text contrast. Renderer screenshots were inspected. This is a pixel UI: native screen-reader semantics are unavailable and are not claimed. OS keyboard event delivery remains a manual check.

responsive.evidence: Both target canvases were rendered and inspected. Status/button overlap found at 960x640 was corrected. Assertions cover control bounds, hit targets, square-frame letterboxing, long hints and disabled interpolation in reduced-motion mode.

loading.evidence: Loading renderer keeps the stage and navigation in place with a preparing-camera label and no save button.

empty.evidence: All four modes render synthetic frames without detected hands; the stage offers a hand instruction and keyboard/mouse controls.

error.evidence: Tests reproduce a failed capture and disk-full save, verify stale-frame expiry, pause, retry and retained Photobooth shots. Camera and save-error screenshots show recovery actions.

partial.evidence: Meme mode without a face renders the preview and controls and explicitly reports wajah belum terlihat; no-face status has a regression test.

success.evidence: The export retry test writes PNG and JSON and returns Photobooth to review. The success screenshot shows confirmation and available next actions.

permission.evidence: The unavailable-camera screen was rendered and start-denial/retry behavior was tested with a simulated exception. The real device-open attempt found no camera in this session, so an actual Windows permission denial could not be exercised.

renderedEvidence.observation: Primary workspace with synthetic camera input, dark sidebar, active/focused mode, retained image aspect ratio and save action.
Compact workspace with a gesture palette and painting strokes. Navigation, hint, status and save action stay separate.
Failed save retains the three-shot strip and displays retry and discard with an explicit error.
Unavailable-camera renderer replaces the stale preview with a persistent recovery screen.
Preparing-camera renderer keeps a stable workspace without a save action.
Meme workspace with no detected face; status is readable outside the preview and the optional M expression meter stays hidden by default.
Saved strip review and confirmation. Frame content is synthetic; no personal camera capture was persisted.
Simulated access-failure message with recovery button; this is renderer evidence, not a real OS permission test.
